title: What Happens to Your Body When You Exercise?
paragraphs: When you walk fast or run, your body works hard. Your heart beats faster. You breathe faster too.
Your muscles need more energy. The blood brings oxygen to the muscles. This helps them move.
Exercise is good for the brain too. After a walk, many people feel happy and calm.
Doctors say adults should move every day. A fast walk for thirty minutes, five days a week, is a good start.
